name: Perceived Greenery In Situ
description: Rebuilt from the published description of Torkko, Poom, Willberg & Toivonen (2023). Participants scan a QR code at one of 20 Helsinki sites (link ?site=S01…S20) and rate the visible greenery around them from 0 to 100; an optional online version rates street-level images instead. Differences from the original study: (1) The in-situ page is shown only when the link contains ?site=...; without it, the online version (not in the original study) is shown.
author: Torkko, Poom, Willberg & Toivonen

config.title: Perceived Greenery
config.description: This short survey asks how much greenery you can see around you.

elements.name: consent
elements.title: I agree to take part in this study and for my answers to be used for research.

elements.name: greenery_in_situ
elements.title: Please evaluate the amount of greenery visible in your surrounding scenery, from 0 (no visible greenery) to 100 (only greenery is visible). Concentrate on natural greenery, i.e., exclude green-coloured cars, buildings, and other artificial objects.

elements.name: greenery_online
elements.title: Please evaluate the amount of greenery visible in this image, from 0 (no visible greenery) to 100 (only greenery is visible). Concentrate on natural greenery, i.e., exclude green-coloured cars, buildings, and other artificial objects.
